integrations.name: Twilio (SMS & Voice)
integrations.description: Twilio powers the text messages and calls in these automations: instant lead replies, appointment reminders, status updates, and two-way SMS conversations that land with the right person on your team.

integrations.name: Slack
integrations.description: Slack is where these automations bring work to your team: internal alerts, approval requests, daily digests, and escalations posted to the channel or person who owns the problem.

integrations.name: Google Sheets
integrations.description: Google Sheets acts as a lightweight database in these automations: logs, trackers, and simple dashboards that update themselves as work happens, with no manual copy and paste.

integrations.name: Mailchimp
integrations.description: Mailchimp runs the email side of these automations: nurture sequences, win-back campaigns, renewal reminders, and segmented messages triggered by real customer activity.

integrations.name: Airtable
integrations.description: Airtable is the backbone for trackers that outgrow a spreadsheet: deal pipelines, compliance logs, inventory, and project records with automatic status changes and alerts.

integrations.name: Jotform
integrations.description: Jotform collects the information that starts the workflow: intake forms, surveys, inspection checklists, and requests that route themselves to the right place the moment they are submitted.

integrations.name: ActiveCampaign
integrations.description: ActiveCampaign combines email marketing with CRM-style automation, making it a strong fit for behavior-based nurture sequences, lead scoring, and lifecycle campaigns.

integrations.name: Google Calendar
integrations.description: Google Calendar keeps schedules in sync: appointments booked by these automations land on the right calendar, and changes trigger confirmations, reminders, and reschedule notices.

integrations.name: HubSpot
integrations.description: HubSpot is the CRM at the center of many of these automations: leads captured and routed, deals advanced by real activity, and follow-up tasks created without manual data entry.

integrations.name: QuickBooks
integrations.description: QuickBooks automations connect finished work to finished books: invoices created from completed jobs, payments recorded and reconciled, and overdue balances followed up on schedule.

integrations.name: Calendly
integrations.description: Calendly handles self-scheduling in these automations, so leads and clients book directly from a text or email and the rest of the workflow starts the moment they do.

integrations.name: Clio
integrations.description: Clio automations help law firms keep intake, matters, deadlines, billing, and client communication moving without paralegals re-keying information between systems.

integrations.name: DocuSign
integrations.description: DocuSign automations send agreements the moment they are ready, chase unsigned documents on a schedule, and kick off the next step as soon as the last signature lands.

integrations.name: Stripe
integrations.description: Stripe automations handle the payment side: deposits and payment links sent automatically, failed charges recovered with reminders, and subscription events synced to the rest of your tools.

integrations.name: Salesforce
integrations.description: Salesforce automations keep larger pipelines honest: leads routed by territory, stale opportunities flagged, and records enriched and updated without reps doing data entry.

integrations.name: Microsoft Outlook
integrations.description: Outlook automations work inside the inbox and calendar your team already lives in: parsing incoming requests, sending templated follow-ups, and keeping meetings in sync.

integrations.name: PandaDoc
integrations.description: PandaDoc automations generate proposals and quotes from your data, track when they are opened, and follow up automatically until they are signed or declined.
